sentenceSets.sentence: His dismissive attitude toward newcomers quickly alienated potential allies.

answerChoices.reasoning: Isolated means separated, but doesn't convey the sense of making someone unfriendly or estranged.
Repelled means driven away, but is less about emotional estrangement and more about physical repulsion.
Offended means made angry or hurt, but doesn't convey the sustained estrangement that alienated implies.
Discouraged means made less confident, but doesn't convey the turning unfriendly that alienated requires.
Separated means divided, but doesn't convey the emotional turning-unfriendly aspect of alienation.
Excluded means left out, but doesn't convey the making-unfriendly aspect of alienation.
Deterred means prevented or discouraged, but doesn't convey making someone hostile or unfriendly.
Antagonized means provoked to hostility, close to alienated, but is more aggressive than the estrangement alienate conveys.
Attracted means drew toward; alienated means made unfriendly—opposite effects.
Welcomed means greeted warmly; dismissive attitude alienates—opposite treatments.
United means brought together; alienated means estranged—opposite effects.

Saddened means made sad, but doesn't convey the turning-hostile or estranged aspect.
Frustrated means annoyed, but doesn't convey making fans hostile toward her.
Troubled means disturbed, but doesn't convey the turning-unfriendly aspect of alienation.
Irritated means annoyed, but doesn't convey the sustained estrangement or turning-hostile aspect.
Endeared means made beloved; alienated means made unfriendly—opposite effects.
Loyal to means remaining steadfast; alienated means estranged—opposite relationships.
Connected to means linked together; alienated means estranged—opposite states.
